diagram_previews.alt: A square with an interior point X above and left of the centre. Solid segments join X to the four corners; blue dashed rays from X meet the left side at its midpoint, the right side at two points, the bottom side at two points and the top side at its midpoint. Dotted horizontal segments from X to the left and right sides are labelled x and 1 - x.
